head: 7eebcd06f42a21d9d5dce641f8442675be076738
claim: Installing the released @byokit/accounts 0.32.0, @byokit/decide 0.16.0, @byokit/dictation 0.6.0 and @byokit/write 0.3.0 (with @byokit/usage 0.10.0) gives a person bins that print their running release version: byokit-accounts, byokit-eval, byokit-dictation-wer and write each answer --version with their release version and no dev build.

target.version: @byokit/accounts 0.32.0, decide 0.16.0, dictation 0.6.0, write 0.3.0, usage 0.10.0 (packed at the release head)

steps.start: a fresh app outside the monorepo with nothing installed
steps: install the five packed release tarballs into the app
run byokit-accounts, byokit-eval, byokit-dictation-wer and write with --version: each prints its release version, not a dev build
run byokit-eval with an unknown flag: refused with exit 2
read the installed accounts package with @byokit/usage's packageVersion: the release channel
before: install the published accounts 0.31.0 and run byokit-accounts --version: refused as an unknown flag
steps.result: every released bin prints its release version; the published predecessor cannot

verdicts.seen: I read the one summary entry and its packing list. It names usage 0.10.0, accounts 0.32.0, decide 0.16.0, dictation 0.6.0 and write 0.3.0, matching the outcome's release set. Its RESULT line says byokit-accounts, byokit-eval, byokit-dictation-wer and write each print their release version with --version and no dev build, and that the published accounts 0.31.0 refuses --version. It points to a detail file I cannot see, so this rests on the summary text alone.

I read all 12 lines of the log. The release head is 7eebcd06..., and the packed versions match the outcome. Each bin's --version output is quoted with exit 0: byokit-accounts 0.32.0, byokit-eval 0.16.0, byokit-dictation-wer 0.6.0, write 0.3.0, each marked 'not a dev build'. The usage check reads the installed accounts as version 0.32.0 on the release channel. The before-check shows published 0.31.0 exiting 2 on --version, which is the contrast the outcome describes.
